id.description: Entity id; the fully-qualified field name for `formField`.

payload.description: Create: full entity; update: RFC 7386 merge patch; delete: `{}` or `{ "reason" }`.

Rect.description:
An axis-aligned rectangle, normalized so `x0 <= x1` and `y0 <= y1`.
Serialises as `[x0, y0, x1, y1]`; validity is enforced by delta validation,
not by serde.

Appearance.description:
`/AP` handling (§4): `regenerate` (default) rebuilds `/AP`; otherwise
`apHash` preserves an imported foreign appearance.

Stroke.description:
One ink stroke; `points` rows are `[x, y, pressure?, tMs?]` — arity 2–4 is
checked by delta validation, not serde.

InkAnnot.description: Keys shared by all annotations (§4), flattened into each subtype payload.

QuadPoints.description:
PDF quad points: 8 numbers, per the PDF spec ordered
`(x1,y1)` upper-left, `(x2,y2)` upper-right, `(x3,y3)` lower-left,
`(x4,y4)` lower-right — in a y-up coordinate space.

MarkupAnnot.description: Keys shared by all annotations (§4), flattened into each subtype payload.

Point.description: A point in PDF user space or device space. Serialises as `[x, y]`.

FreeTextAnnot.description: Keys shared by all annotations (§4), flattened into each subtype payload.

TextAnnot.description: Keys shared by all annotations (§4), flattened into each subtype payload.

d.description: SVG-path-like mini-language (`M L C Z` only).

StampAnnot.description: Keys shared by all annotations (§4), flattened into each subtype payload.

ShapeAnnot.description: Keys shared by all annotations (§4), flattened into each subtype payload.

LineAnnot.description: Keys shared by all annotations (§4), flattened into each subtype payload.

FormField.description:
`target: "formField"` payload (§7.1). `id` on the op is the fully-qualified
`name`.

SignatureFieldState.description: Whether a signature field can accept a new signature, not its validity.

FieldFlags.description: `/Ff` bits — common (1/2/3) plus the per-type flags of §7.2.

exportValue.description: Per-kid export value (`/AP /N` non-`Off` state key).

fieldName.description: Fully-qualified `/T`; creates the field if absent.

rect.description: May be `[0,0,0,0]` for an invisible signature.

graphicRef.description: `Ink`/`Stamp` annotation id whose content is copied into `/n2`.

description.description: Text displayed in the signature appearance.
